propositions.statement: Under the tested native formulation, the reference-centered triplet is a whole-expression computational relation. Symmetry reference, orientation roles, and distinction capacity are OTM-exposed aspects that are independently nameable but not independently realizable.
propositions.local_governance_mapping: C2_model_relative / bounded internal synthesis; no C5 claim licensed.
propositions.supporting_observation: The four attacks jointly report reference dependence, whole-relation identity constraints, a candidate I1-I3 basis, and mutual dependency under tested constructions.
disagreements_and_alternatives: A richer standard representation may preserve the tested distinctions.
A simpler native relation may reproduce the behavior.
OTM may expose only a reachable subset rather than all lawful decompositions.
limitations: Program M and Program S are same-campaign implementations.
Uniqueness, OTM completeness, and multiplicity remain open.
